description: Add unit tests for the order service, checkout component, and order confirmation component.
steps: Create src/app/services/order.service.spec.ts following cart.service.spec.ts pattern. Test: service creation, placeOrder creates and stores order, getLastOrder returns null initially, getLastOrder returns placed order, clearOrder resets to null.

Create src/app/components/checkout/checkout.component.spec.ts following cart.component.spec.ts pattern. Test: component creation, form invalid when empty, card number validation, CVV validation, expiry date validation, submit button disabled when invalid, successful submission navigates to /order-confirmation.
Create src/app/components/order-confirmation/order-confirmation.component.spec.ts. Test: component creation, displays order details when order exists, shows continue shopping link.
acceptance_criteria: New tests are meaningful and exercise actual component/service logic
